program.name: Two-Split 60 Tempo II
program.subject: Signature
program.blurb: Two-Split 60 Tempo, one level harder: every day starts where the original's Level II did, with the newer moves in the mix.
program.about: The same two-day rhythm as Two-Split 60: upper body, then lower body, each finished with abs, in straight sets. Two-Split 60 moves you one weight up and then adds reps; this one keeps the weights and slows down, with a three-second lowering on every move that can take it at Levels II and III. Slower reps take longer, so a session holds fewer sets and stays in its time range. This II is the same program one level up, with the newest moves in the mix, and its Level III adds a set where the day has room.
